name: Alt Àneu (Spain)
description: Quartered by a cross set at the first third of the length, red at the upper hoist and lower fly and white in the other quarters, with yellow, purple and green gussets (escaires) at the crossing.
history: The official flag of Alt Àneu is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, quartered by a cross over the first third of the length, the upper hoist and lower fly quarters red and the other two white; the flag takes the colours of the arms for the fields, and the figures of the arms are transformed into gussets: the golden castle of the first quarter and the cross of the fourth are the yellow gussets, the Agnus Dei of the second is the purple gusset and the chamois of the third the green gusset. Approved on 23 August 1995 and published in the DOGC on 6 September 1995.
